propositions: Whole-body pandoc 3.6.1 escapes code-span arrows, deletes HTML comments including rebar's reconciler-echo marker, and corrupts arrow delimiters in comment terminators.
A segmenting two-phase lexer must lock complete {noformat} spans, HTML comments, backtick/tilde fences, and four-space blocks before classification to prevent content destruction.
Post-render code-preservation check must require every code fragment from source to appear verbatim in output, falling back to original Markdown on mismatch to handle unpredictable escaping.

Inline-Jira classifier must split wiki markers into UNAMBIGUOUS forms ({{…}}, [a|b], {color:}) that settle a unit alone versus AMBIGUOUS forms (*x*, _x_) that only settle units with no CommonMark-only markers, preventing 2-cycle re-rendering of rich bullets.

Deterministic scrubbed 178-body corpus (29 code-arrow, 29 table, 120 prose) with pinned strata must achieve ≥0.90 body ratio and ≥0.95 character ratio of eligible units rendering rich, with proof of non-vacuous dispatch and change.

Missing pypandoc returns exact body and warns wiki_render_fallback with reason=pandoc_absent; conversion or preservation failure returns exact unit and debugs with reason=conversion_failure or preservation_failure, never logging bodies.
